reason: IrfanView already opens my phone photos, screenshots and PDFs fine, and I have my shortcuts and plug-ins set up. I'd grab the portable zip out of curiosity, open a few files, and go back.
why_switch_or_not: Faster next/back is nice on paper, but my pictures are phone photos and screenshots and IrfanView already opens them fast enough that I never wait. The extra stuff (RAW, 3D, editor, gallery) is stuff I don't use, and I'd have to re-do my shortcuts and the file associations for no gain. It's one developer on version 0.4.1 with no plug-in system, so there's no reason to move over my setup.
current_app_pros: It opens instantly from an Explorer double-click, my shortcuts are in my fingers, my plug-ins are set up, and it's free and has never crashed on me.
objection: I don't want to relearn anything or have my colour and file-handling setup change. 'Set default' is a manual job in Windows Settings, and a new one-person app could break or lose support.
would_change_my_mind: If IrfanView stopped working on Windows or I started getting file types it can't open, or if NuViewer had the same shortcuts as IrfanView out of the box.
